# Diffsense

> > Diffsense delivers in-depth geopolitical analysis, examining conflicts in the Middle East, institutional integrity, and the intersection of policy, technology, and global risk.

The site focuses on critical analysis of international relations, particularly Iran conflict dynamics, U.S. institutional independence (Federal Reserve, DOJ), energy security in the Persian Gulf, and emerging geopolitical risks across Washington, Tehran, Brussels, and beyond. Coverage spans military strategy, economic policy, legal frameworks, and technology governance.

## Key Topics

- Iran conflict and Middle East tensions
- Federal Reserve independence
- Department of Justice investigations
- Geopolitical risk assessment
- Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz security
- Naval warfare and missile defense
- Energy security and supply chains
- U.S. foreign policy and strategic delay
- Post-government ethics
- Monetary policy and inflation
- Pentagon and defense policy
- AI regulation and privacy
- International law and autonomous weapons
- European energy crisis
- Political retribution and institutional integrity

- [The Cold Radiator and the Distant Fuse](https://diffsense.com/cold-radiator-distant-fuse): European energy crisis and Iran conflict supply chain vulnerabilities
- [The Invisible Breadline and the Echo of a Distant Storm](https://diffsense.com/invisible-breadline-echo-distant-storm): Cairo food security crisis and global supply chain disruptions
